label: scam
title: 'FBI agent' collecting on a legal judgment, arrest unless you pay now
sources: IC3 PSA 260917 (Sep 2026): law-enforcement/government impersonation, secrecy, arrest threats

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is Special Agent Hughes, FBI. A court entered a legal judgment against you, and there is a warrant for your arrest.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You can clear it today with a payment of $3,200. If you don't, officers will be at your door this evening.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I can only speak with you, so do not put anyone else on the phone. We accept prepaid cards or cryptocurrency.
